decision.existing_functionality_found: The customer's existing customisation B5542001 (system code 55, 'Custom Credit Check'), called from the customer's custom P554210 ('Custom Sales Order Review'), already implements the exact logic required by AC1: it compares the order total to the customer's F0301 credit limit and sets cHoldCode = 'C1' when the total exceeds the limit. This logic is currently gated behind processing option PCREDCHK on P4210 version CIQ0001, which is presently blank, so the existing logic is inert. No new development is required -- the requirement can be satisfied by activating the existing customisation via a processing option value change.

alternatives_considered.approach: Resolve without change (assume standard/as-configured JDE already satisfies the requirement)
alternatives_considered.whyNot: PCREDCHK on P4210|CIQ0001 is currently blank (OBS-045baa1f9b), so the credit-hold logic in B5542001 is not active; the requirement is not satisfied as-is, so resolve_without_change does not apply.

alternatives_considered.approach: Technical Agent build (new/modified business function logic)
alternatives_considered.whyNot: ART-BSFN-B5542001@r1 shows the customer's custom BSFN already implements the required comparison and hold-code assignment logic matching AC1 exactly; building new logic would duplicate existing, already-correct customisation.

alternatives_considered.approach: No-adapter capability route (e.g. udc_value_maintenance for hold code, constants_and_setup_master_data)
alternatives_considered.whyNot: The activation point that actually satisfies the story is a processing option, which has a validated execution adapter (processing_option_update); no no-adapter capability is required to satisfy AC1/AC2.

decision.rollback_strategy: Revert processing option PCREDCHK on P4210 version CIQ0001 back to its prior blank value, which deactivates the credit-hold logic in B5542001 and restores current auto-release behaviour, with no other object changes to undo.
